arguments.command:
ls -la /app && file /app/main.db && python3 - <<'PY'
import sqlite3
p='/app/main.db'
try:
    c=sqlite3.connect(f'file:{p}?mode=ro', uri=True)
    print('journal_mode:', c.execute('pragma journal_mode').fetchone())
    print('tables:', c.execute("select name, sql from sqlite_master where type='table'").fetchall())
    for (name,) in c.execute("select name from sqlite_master where type='table'"):
        print(name, c.execute(f'SELECT * FROM "{name}"').fetchall())
    c.close()
except Exception as e:
    print(type(e).__name__,e)
PY
